leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a tabbed interface with clickable tab buttons and corresponding content panels.
Initialize and manage the active tab state using JavaScript.
Implement keyboard event handlers to navigate between tabs using arrow keys.
Control focus management to ensure keyboard users can interact with the active tab content.
Update the UI dynamically to reflect the currently selected tab and its content.
Integrate ARIA attributes to enhance accessibility for screen reader users.
Manipulate DOM elements to show and hide tab panels based on user interaction.
